description: This file defines a function to generate a development plan from gap analysis results, leveraging data models for development plans and gap analysis results.

classes.name: DevelopmentPlan
classes.description: Data model representing a development plan containing multiple steps.

classes.name: DevelopmentPlanStep
classes.description: Data model representing a single step within a development plan.

classes.name: GapAnalysisResult
classes.description: Data model containing results from a gap analysis, including a list of gaps.

methods.name: DevelopmentPlan generate_plan_from_gaps(gaps: GapAnalysisResult)
methods.description: Creates a DevelopmentPlan based on the provided GapAnalysisResult, generating steps to bridge competency gaps.
